text: BAM share rose 0.05 percentage points over 22 hours to 34.4%, while over 7 days it still fell 0.09 percentage points. Leadership moved to ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee via whale-driven routing, and concentration remains elevated: the largest node holds 22.3% of BAM stake and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. New cross-region node signals are visible, but the validated structural rollover record remains the fra event on 2026-06-24.
